description: OpenAI-compatible chat completions on Alibaba Qwen 3.8 27B, the newest Qwen with reasoning, tool calling and a 262K context. Set your OpenAI SDK base URL to https://agents.citiviewgroup.com/v1/qwen3.8 and pay per token with x402 instead of an API key: $0.9 per million input and $6.4 per million output tokens, minimum $0.002 a call, at most $0.1059. The 402 quotes your request's maximum; "upto" payers are charged only the tokens used. Same request/response shape as OpenAI (tool calling, reasoning, streaming supported), up to 8192 output tokens. Costs $0.1059 USDC per call (x402).
